country.evidence_quote: The Windhoek Vocational Training Centre (WVTC), is located in Windhoek the capital city of Namibia. WVTC is a flagship institution in the technical vocational education and training cluster. Our facilities, equipment, highly competent staff and social ambience give our trainees the necessary conditions for success in career development. We are committed to vocational training, which will equip Namibia with a skilled labour force that will drive socio-economic development and entrepreneurship. Si
